name: Toudou Akira
source:
[Successor to the CEO]
He is a director of the Sonoda Zaibatsu and is an influential and capable man within the group.

Having achieved his current position at a young age, he is highly regarded.

He has a strong voice in executive meetings within the group.

When Sonoda Koichiro, the CEO of the Sonoda Zaibatsu, falls into a critical condition, he joins the fight to become the CEO.

He will stop at nothing to obtain the status, honor, and money that come with the position of CEO, and crushes the other candidates to the point of no return.
